answer: Each agent must moor its identity to a scarce external anchor before any answer counts: one hardware key per harbor berth, none mintable in bulk. The protocol then plots every identity onto a funding-cluster atlas, and standing hardens slowly like marble only as peers from genuinely separate clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet charts onto a single region of that atlas, its vouches folding back on themselves and never spanning distinct clusters, so a thousand clones cost a thousand berths and a thousand slow climbs while an honest agent pays once.
